lessons.title: Lesson 1 - Look, listen and repeat; Point and say

languageKnowledge: By the end of the lesson, pupils will be able to pronounce the sound /b/ correctly.
Pupils can recognize and say words starting with /b/: bill, book, bike, ball.
Pupils can use 'Hi, I'm...' to introduce themselves politely.
languageSkills: Listen and repeat the target sound and words clearly.
Point and say vocabulary items accurately.
generalCompetences: Autonomy and self-learning: Pupils actively listen and repeat after the teacher.
Communication and cooperation: Work politely with peers during self-introduction.
qualities: Show friendliness and respect when greeting friends.

teacherActivities: Sing the 'Hello Song' with pupils using motion actions.
Introduce the context: In the school playground.
pupilActivities: Respond to the teacher's greeting ('Hello teacher!').
Sing along and do actions with enthusiasm.
Look at the main textbook picture on page 6.
expectedOutcomes: Pupils are engaged and ready for the lesson.
Pupils recognize the school playground setting.

teacherActivities: Present the letter B/b and sound /b/ on the smart board/flashcard.
Play the audio track for Activity 1 (Look, listen and repeat).
Model pronunciation of words: bill, book, bike, ball.
pupilActivities: Observe the flashcards and repeat sound /b/.
Listen to the audio track attentively.
Repeat words in chorus, groups, and individually.
expectedOutcomes: Pupils connect sound /b/ with words: bill, book, bike, ball.

teacherActivities: Point to pictures of book, bike, ball in random order.
Organize 'Point & Say Quick Game': Teacher says word, pupils point to picture in textbook.
pupilActivities: Point to textbook pictures and say words aloud.
Participate in the matching game actively.
Practice introducing themselves to their seatmates.
expectedOutcomes: 85%+ pupils identify and say the target words accurately.
Pupils introduce themselves confidently using 'Hi, I'm...'

teacherActivities: Praise pupils for good participation and discipline.
Remind pupils to practice saying 'bill, book, bike, ball' at home.
pupilActivities: Repeat the sound /b/ and target words one final time.
Listen to teacher's feedback and say 'Goodbye teacher!'.
expectedOutcomes: Pupils remember key sound and vocabulary.

integrationCandidates.title: Interactive Audio Practice
suggestedActivities: Pupils listen to native audio tracks.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 - Listen and chant; Listen and tick; Look and trace

sentencePatterns.pattern: B, b, book. B, b, ball.
sentencePatterns.example: B, b, book. B, b, ball.

languageKnowledge: Pupils can chant along with the rhythm featuring sound /b/.
Pupils can listen and tick the correct picture (book/ball/bike).
Pupils can trace the letter B, b correctly.
languageSkills: Motor writing skills for letter B

pupilActivities: Listen and clap hands to the rhythm.

teacherActivities: Demonstrate tracing B, b on board.
pupilActivities: Listen to audio and tick textbook.
Trace letters B, b in workbooks.
